description: This file contains Redux reducer functions for managing integrations-related state in a Mattermost application, including incoming/outgoing webhooks, commands, OAuth apps, OAuth connections, bot IDs, and dialog data.

methods.name: incomingHooks
methods.description: Reducer for managing incoming webhook objects keyed by their IDs.

methods.name: incomingHooksTotalCount
methods.description: Reducer for tracking total count of incoming hooks.

methods.name: outgoingHooks
methods.description: Reducer for managing outgoing webhook objects keyed by their IDs.

methods.name: commands
methods.description: Reducer for managing command objects keyed by their IDs.

methods.name: systemCommands
methods.description: Reducer for managing built-in slash commands, keyed by trigger.

methods.name: oauthApps
methods.description: Reducer for managing OAuth application objects keyed by their IDs.

methods.name: appsOAuthAppIDs
methods.description: Reducer for list of OAuth app IDs.

methods.name: outgoingOAuthConnections
methods.description: Reducer for managing outgoing OAuth connection objects keyed by their IDs.

methods.name: appsBotIDs
methods.description: Reducer for list of bot IDs associated with apps.

methods.name: dialogArguments
methods.description: Reducer for storing dialog argument data.

methods.name: dialogTriggerId
methods.description: Reducer for storing dialog trigger ID.
